name: Radclyffe
knownFor: Lesbian romance novelist and founder of Bold Strokes Books.
bio: Radclyffe is the pen name of Dr. Lenora Ruth Barot, an American author of lesbian romance, paranormal romance, erotica and mystery. She trained as a surgeon, graduating from the University of Pennsylvania School of Medicine in 1976, and retired from medicine in 2004 to write and publish full time.

In 2004 she founded the independent LGBTQ+ publishing company Bold Strokes Books, whose mission is to publish quality LGBTQ+ fiction and give opportunities to own-voices authors. She is also a founder of the Golden Crown Literary Society, and writes in long, linked series of romances.

events.text: Graduated from the University of Pennsylvania School of Medicine.
Retired from surgery and founded Bold Strokes Books.
The Lambda Literary Foundation gave her the Dr. James Duggins Outstanding Mid-Career Novelist award.
Featured in Love Between the Covers, an award-winning documentary about the romance-writing and reading community.
Named a Trailblazer in Romance by the Romance Writers of America for her LGBTQ+ fiction.

relevance: Radclyffe has probably done more than any single person to make lesbian romance a self-sustaining publishing category: she writes it at length, and she built the press that publishes other authors in it.
influence: Her awards include the Lambda Literary Award and the Golden Crown Literary Award, and she is a member of the Saints and Sinners Literary Hall of Fame. Bold Strokes Books has published a large share of the genre's authors since 2004.
